title: Jesus... I Laugh Loudest In The Group Chat And Cry After. 😅
topic: he is the loudest laugh in the group chat and the quietest cry in his room, and he thinks admitting it makes him the sad friend

bible.text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I laugh the loudest in the group chat. Then I cry after.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Sent three memes. Then sat on my floor and didn't know why.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You made laughter your shield. It's heavy.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: If I say I'm not okay, I stop being the funny one.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You were never the funny one to Me. You were loved first. Put the shield down.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Ask your soul why it's cast down. It's allowed to answer.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend with the joke always ready. 😅
